notes: No supported simultaneous save damage effect requests independent per-target rolls.
Attack rolls, later per-creature ticks, delayed Vitriolic Sphere damage, and later commanded activations are independent.
Flame Strike, Destructive Wave, Ice Storm and Jallarzi components have distinct rolls, each shared across simultaneous victims.
Ice Knife and Lightning Arrow attack damage is separate from the shared saving-throw splash.
Magic Missile retains its explicit shared roll; Sear Undead already shares one roll.
